text:
alice: Heads up — rolling deploy for model-router v2 starts in ~30m during change window (23:00-02:00 UTC). Plan: staged FF ramp + 5% pin fallback to v1 for noisy cohorts.

ben: ack. what's the rollout cadence?

alice: cadence: enable 10% at t0 (cohort slices), monitor 15m. If OK -> +20% -> 30%, monitor 20m, then gradual to 100% over 30m. Abort conditions: 5xx rate >1%, P95 latency +200ms, error-budget burn >10% in 15m.

carla: adding release-bot checklist. deploy-bot will tag deploy id. pushed canary image: registry.redwood/model-router:v2-rc3

deploy-bot: Deploy started — id: dpl-20240315-47; canary on 4 hosts.

ben: remind me how to pin to v1 for a cohort?

alice: FF API quick example:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"flag":"routing_v2","cohort":"slices:0-4","percent":5,"pin":"v1"}'
```
(use double-check in staging first)

carla: suggest we enable shed mode before full enable: if backend error rate climbs, shed 50% of v2 traffic back to v1.

janet: I'll watch the dashboards (P50/P95/P99, 5xx, cost). paging @devops-oncall for the window.

devops-oncall: I'm oncall. If abort: run `ff toggle routing_v2 0` then drain v2 pods and rollback image to previous tag. I can run that immediately.

marco: add cache warmup step — pre-warm KV cache on v2 for slices 0..9 with synthetic requests 10m before traffic shift. avoids cold KV penalties.

alice: agreed. also keep v2 pinned to internal sessions for 2h before public 100% ramp. Release notes blurb: "Model router v2: improved batching and KV cache; expected 10-20% token-cost reduction; monitor latency/regressions."

ben: +1 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy status update: canary healthy for 12m. dpl-20240315-47 canary-ok.

alice: starting 10% enable now.

carla: logs show a short burst of 500s (~200s), looks like a downstream timeout, not model errors.

alice: monitoring. holding for 15m then move to 30% if stable.

deploy-bot: traffic-slicing update: routing_v2 = 30% (applied)

janet: P95 +60ms, P50 flat. 5xx at 0.25% — within thresholds. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/model-router/2024-03-15

devops-oncall: no pages yet. ready to pin cohorts if anything spikes.

alice: proceeding to full ramp in 25m unless we see regressions. If 5xx >1% or error budget burn >10% in 15m, we'll pin cohorts 0-4 to v1 and open rollback.

carla: pinned cohort range 0-4 -> v1 (command run).

ben: I'll add an operational note in the release notes about the cohort pin fallback.

marco: reminder: unpin after 48h if stable, otherwise escalate to platform infra.

alice: Runbook snippet:
1) Abort/rollback: `ff toggle routing_v2 0` && rollout v1 tag `dpl-previous` across shards.
2) Pin affected cohorts: `ff pin routing_v2 --cohorts 0-4 --target v1`
3) Notify customers + CD team, open incident if >30m.

deploy-bot: Follow-up created: infra#9876 (post-deploy validation + unpin checklist) — closing thread.

alice: thanks all — will post final release notes after 48h of stability. :white_check_mark:
